policy: Public API directories are discovery lists, not universal keys or a guarantee of commercial rights. No credentials ship. Respect each provider's current terms, quotas, attribution and content licenses.

sources.name: GDELT news discovery
sources.coverage: International article metadata and links; search coverage varies.
sources.limits: One bounded request; 15-minute query cache; provider throttling/backoff respected.
sources.rights: News discovery does not grant article or image reuse rights.

sources.name: Wikipedia topic discovery
sources.coverage: English encyclopedia title/snippet search; verify claims against underlying primary sources.
sources.limits: Bounded metadata, descriptive User-Agent and 15-minute query cache.
sources.rights: Wikipedia text has attribution/share-alike terms; individual media licenses differ.

sources.name: Crossref scholarly metadata
sources.coverage: DOI titles, publishers, dates and canonical links; metadata is not full-text access.
sources.limits: One concurrent public request, 15-minute cache; inspect live headers for rate limits.
sources.rights: Full papers, abstracts and images may have separate copyright/license terms.

sources.name: Hacker News discussions
sources.coverage: Technology questions, launches and discussions; not a representative general audience sample.
sources.limits: Bounded recent story results; 15-minute cache and provider backoff.
sources.rights: Link and attribute; user comments retain their applicable rights.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.coverage: Scholarly discovery; basic access and heavier usage have different budgets.
sources.limits: Check current provider account/docs; no shared key included.
sources.rights: Metadata and source publication rights differ.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.coverage: Research preprints; not necessarily peer-reviewed or established facts.
sources.limits: Respect published API pacing and bulk-use policies.
sources.rights: Each paper declares its own reuse license.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.coverage: Media discovery with individual licensing and attribution metadata.
sources.limits: Respect Wikimedia usage policy; validate each original file before reuse.
sources.rights: A file being public does not remove its attribution/license conditions.

sources.name: YouTube official APIs
sources.auth: owner OAuth / owner API key as appropriate
sources.coverage: Authorized channel/video statistics and public discovery; Analytics scopes are separate.
sources.limits: Account-specific quota. Never scrape credentials or promise unlimited free use.
sources.rights: Video metadata access does not grant video download/reuse rights.

sources.name: Instagram official APIs
sources.coverage: Own professional-account media/insights where actually granted; not arbitrary competitor analytics.
sources.limits: App review, eligibility, metric availability and rate limits apply.
sources.rights: Account consent and content publication approval are separate.

sources.name: Publisher-provided RSS/Atom
sources.coverage: A publisher's permitted feed; verify publication time against event time.
sources.limits: Use the publisher's documented feed and caching policy.
sources.rights: A feed subscription does not grant article republication rights.
